name_reason: Follows data_fd2_battle_* convention for a battle-core scratch global; descriptor 'ai_best_physical_target_idx' accurately reflects role (runtime_char index of the chosen best physical-attack target) and the value is read/written as a full dword scalar. 'idx' is a descriptor (index), not a Ghidra address residue. Consistent with grouped siblings _target_x/_target_y/_score @ 0x53C43/0x53C47/0x53C4F.
purpose: Enemy-AI scratch slot holding the runtime_char index of the best physical-attack target chosen by fd2_ai_score_physical_attack; consumed by the executor fd2_execute_ai_physical_attack to drive the attack/animation and by fd2_attack_action_dispatch to pre-compute the counter delta.
logic_summary: fd2_ai_score_physical_attack (writer @0x144EF) stores the winning target's byte id (zero-extended into the dword) whenever a candidate beats the running best (score class, raw_dmg tiebreak). It is reset implicitly via the paired score reset of ai_best_physical_score at entry. Readers (fd2_execute_ai_physical_attack many sites, fd2_attack_action_dispatch @0x14F3A) load it as a full dword and compute the runtime_char address as idx*0x50 + data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr, passing it as the chosen target index to attack/animation/counter routines.
element_semantics: Unsigned runtime_char index (0-based) of the selected best physical-attack target; byte target-id zero-extended into the 32-bit BSS scalar. runtime_char base = idx*0x50 + data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr.
notes: BSS scalar in .object2 (read_memory returns zeros -> runtime variable, not const data). is_const=false because of the game-side writer at 0x144EF in fd2_ai_score_physical_attack. src comment block (btl_aisc.c lines 689-700) is already accurate (datatype, writer, readers, idx*0x50 addressing, group membership) -> comment_verdict=keep, no Edit. No data-address plate exists; the group is documented in the writer's function plate @0x14237 ('ai_best_physical_target_idx @ 0x53C4B - target runtime_char index'), which is accurate -> ghidra_plate_action=none. Name kept; any rename would happen in Stage 2 anyway.
